To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of social networks is more intense before the travel than after the trip.
students use social media during the three phrases of travel process, but their use is different in each phase.
social media are important for students during the travel planning phase and to a lesser degree during the travel and after travel.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of social networks by students in the three phases of travel.
the students’ social media use in the travel process and provides new insights to the literature.
the use of social and digital media among students as an important segment in the travel process and the underlying dimensions of the use of social networking sites among students.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
social media are important for students in all three phases of the pre-travel, during-travel and post-travel phases of the travel experience.
social media are used before travel and less during and less after travel.
social media have an impact on the travel process of students.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of social networks by students before travel is mainly driven by the need for information and opinions, during travel by the need to stay connected with their friends and to get more information, and after travel by the need for sociability and information.
the use of social networking sites is a significant part of the travel experience of students.
students’ use of the social media during the three phases in the travel process has a significant role in their decision to travel and in their travel satisfaction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social media are not only a source of information for students, but also an important means of socializing with other people.
the travel industry needs to take into consideration the students’ use and preferences of social media during each phase of the travel process in order to be more competitive.
social media are not a replacement for traditional sources of information.
